text:
marie_sales: Heads-up: Prospect NorthHarbor wants BYO-KMS (HSM) for their POC. They're hosting the HSM behind an outbound proxy and asked for egress rules, pen-test window, and a POC quote for BYO-KMS.

jason_eng: We can deploy the keybroker as a sidecar or managed connector in their VPC. Requirements: outbound TLS on 443 to their endpoint, support for mTLS or client-cert passthrough. If their proxy terminates TLS we need a passthrough or the connector won't authenticate.

ravi_ops: Network detail: allow outbound 443 to their IP ranges/FQDN. If proxy does TLS interception add ~30-90ms per unwrap depending on RTT. For tight latency (p95 <60ms) recommend dedicated routing or colocated gateway.

emma_sec: For security questionnaire ask for HSM vendor/model, FIPS attestation, key exportability, rotation cadence and operator custody process, SOC2 report, and firmware update policy. Also confirm keys never leave HSM in plaintext.

marie_sales: They proposed pen-test week of 2026-07-06. Is that workable?

emma_sec: Yes if they provide scope & IPs 72h prior. Quick bullets to include in Q list: 1) Redwood does not persist plaintext keys, 2) BYO-KMS requires a customer client cert for unwraps, 3) coordinate rotation windows (we recommend 60-120 min for cutover), 4) attestation needed before prod flip.

chris_se: Pricing: BYO-KMS add-on = integration fee + per-unwrap routing charge + optional reserved capacity for dedicated routing. For POC we often waive the integration fee with a committed pilot. Need expected unwraps/sec and log retention to price.

marie_sales: They estimate 80 rps peak, ~7k/day, want 90d logs.

chris_se: Rough POC quote: waive integration fee for pilot; ops/routing add-on ~$1,800/mo + $0.002 per unwrap; recommend Dedicated routing if they want stable p95 latency. I'll draft formal numbers.

jason_eng: POC runbook: run connector in their VPC with private link; we can provide a small load harness. Example command to simulate:

```
wrk -t6 -c100 -d45s https://staging-kms.northharbor.internal/unwrap
```

Collect TLS handshakes and verify client cert forwarding.

ravi_ops: Pen-test week works for infra if scope provided 72h ahead and tests are non-destructive. infra-bot: pen-test preflight checklist: https://redwood.internal/pen-test-preflight

marie_sales: Action items: 1) @emma_sec create Q list and send to customer today, 2) @chris_se prepare POC quote including dedicated routing option, 3) @jason_eng prepare sidecar runbook + harness, 4) @ravi_ops prepare pen-test preflight and IP list. I'll schedule a 20m sync with NorthHarbor tomorrow.

infra-bot: Reminder: attestation artifact required before production cutover. See BYO-KMS doc: https://redwood.internal/byo-kms-guidelines

marie_sales: Sending the questionnaire in 30m unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:
